title: The other hand on the new testament
html_source:
Darwinian biology was (and is) seen as a threat to the normally accepted Catholic doctrine, Creationism.

There is great contrast here with one placing “one hand on The Origin of Species” and “the other hand on the new testament”, as they forward what are often seen as entirely conflicting views.
